title: VEIL · PHYLOGENY — take time, fill the trees. clothes of paint. exude one form; paint the other on top.

do_not_reinvent.vitruvian: /data/vitruvian-cayley.json — tour of O, not phylogeny. THIS file fills phylogeny WITH time.
do_not_reinvent.tree: tree-of-life.json — already a count of files
do_not_reinvent.time_Y: /data/human-seat-pi-step-time.json — time fills independently even without steps
do_not_reinvent.inner_outer: INNER form ? OUTER paint. same as inner?outer null.

take_time_fill_trees.do: let Y (relative independent time) run through the ENTIRE trees and phylogeny
take_time_fill_trees.not: rank species as medals. not a danger table of clades.
take_time_fill_trees.yes: every branch gets duration — how long that form has been sitting in the hard place of Earth
take_time_fill_trees.phylogeny: nominal Order of relatedness first; time fills depth; editions contrast ancestors
take_time_fill_trees.entire: not only the Vitruvian five. kingdoms ? phyla ? genera — fill as priors ±error (appleSeed), not CERTAINTY

veil_as_clothes.what: a covering that can HOLD paint and color — chromatograph clothes, not skin
veil_as_clothes.can: receive rainbow-sort / VDJ chromatic strokes without rewriting the exuded form
veil_as_clothes.is_not: the body. is not the phylogeny. is clothes.
veil_as_clothes.like: scaffold invert — visible print on this side; can be changed without killing the rock

exude_from_inside.what: one form pushed OUT from within — fruiting body, CNS anatomy, phylogeny-as-lived, the rock
exude_from_inside.tense: IS the body that time filled
exude_from_inside.null: INNER pale if a branch is unset — growth plate, not court

paint_on_top.what: the other form laid ON the veil — color, clothes, persona, medal-costume if we are not careful
paint_on_top.tense: NOW / NEAR — can iterate without dissolving the exuded form
paint_on_top.refuse: do not pretend paint IS the phylogeny. that mixes inner/outer.

two_forms.together: exude one, paint the other. Klein two faces of one animal. veil sits between.

pipeline: take time (Y) — fill trees/phylogeny as duration priors
exude inner form (body / clade as lived)
paint chromatic / story on the veil
never mix: painted medal ? exuded branch
berry_at_the_fire: take time and fill the entire trees and phylogeny. cover with a veil as clothes that can hold paint and color. we exude one form from inside. we paint the other on top. two forms, one animal. the veil is the clothes — not the skin.
next: when naming a clade, stamp: exuded vs painted. veil can change color without rewriting the tree.
